_comment: SHARED choice-dialog modal (scenes/shared/ — Aaron 2026-08-14 ruling 2A3592D0: pop-up modals are shared modal TREES, one definition, no per-scene copy). The confirm.scene.json shape: a full-bleed `surface` with a `screens.confirm` backdrop cell under a centered `popup_panel`. EVERYTHING it says comes from the HOST through the Model — the shell's `SharedModal` scene publishes `modal_title` / `modal_body` and each slot's `opt<n>_label` / `opt<n>_variant` / `opt<n>_shown` from the typed `ModalParams` a bench hands it, so the tree is never rewritten per caller. Three fixed slots: a slot the caller does not fill stays dark (`visible_bind`), and each fires its stable slot name (`modal_opt_0..2`), which `SharedModal` maps back to the caller's own action before it closes. Esc / pad-B fold to `modal_cancel` via the root `on_cancel`, honoured only when the caller declared the modal cancellable (exactly as pause folds to `resume`). NO `behaviour` key (the manifest skips scenes/shared/); NO pair script (the params ARE the arrangement); chrome styles ride Main.scene.json's carrier through `main_scene_styles()`.
